policy: The raw candidate is immutable. Active product changes respond only to observed fake, inspect, source, or real acceptance findings.

changes.finding: An empty GROK_HOME with normal HOME and 12 compatibility switches disabled still exposed four native .agents skills and one Cursor MCP server in inspect.
changes.activeChange: Stage both cwd and HOME, keep GROK_HOME separate for auth, and preflight effective configuration.

changes.finding: The historical real argv used bare star as a deny, but pinned source parses it as an Any pattern instead of a global tool-wide deny.
changes.activeChange: Replace it with bare Read and bare MCPTool deny classes.

changes.finding: A restrictive allowlist still advertised todo_write, search_tool, and use_tool in the real runtime init.
changes.activeChange: Freeze the exact surface, reject surface drift in automatic mode, deny its Read and MCPTool access classes, and reject any emitted local or server tool call.

changes.finding: Local Grok help says --json-schema implies JSON, while the real 1.0.3 call emitted streaming init and result frames when streaming-messages-json was also explicit.
changes.activeChange: Freeze flag order and require streaming init for automatic acceptance.

changes.finding: The only real call used default-profile OAuth, not a dedicated authenticated profile.
changes.activeChange: Require a stable dedicated non-default profile and detected auth presence for automatic mode, and leave automatic policy disabled.

changes.finding: Full real inspect output contained unrelated bundled skill descriptions.
changes.activeChange: Retain only a trust-bearing inspect summary with counts, boolean states, and compatibility cells.

changes.finding: The raw candidate could enter an automatic consultation after a clean fake preflight even though no dedicated-profile real acceptance existed.
changes.activeChange: Add a mechanical false acceptance gate that stops automatic mode after non-model preflight and before consultation.

changes.finding: A zero-exit streaming result could carry is_error=true with a success subtype, end_turn, and valid structured review.
changes.activeChange: Classify the result as incomplete before accepting the structured review.

changes.finding: The raw numeric check accepted unbounded max-turns and non-finite or arbitrarily large timeout values.
changes.activeChange: Accept max-turns only from 1 through 8 and finite timeouts greater than zero through 600 seconds, with exact boundary fixtures.
